'''Alessia''' was the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tarsa]], that was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was the site of a large Imperial base.<ref name="EA" /> It was presumably the homeworld of the [[Alessian terror moth]], a species of creature that lived on Tarsa.<ref name="YS">''[[Star Wars: Yoda Stories]]''</ref>
